class.name: RenderSceneBuffersRD
class.brief_description: Render scene buffer implementation for the RenderingDevice based renderers.
class.description: This object manages all 3D rendering buffers for the rendering device based renderers. An instance of this object is created for every viewport that has 3D rendering enabled. See also [RenderSceneBuffers]. All buffers are organized in [b]contexts[/b]. The default context is called [b]render_buffers[/b] and can contain amongst others the color buffer, depth buffer, velocity buffers, VRS density map and MSAA variants of these buffers. Buffers are only guaranteed to exist during rendering of the viewport. [b]Note:[/b] This is an internal rendering server object. Do not instantiate this class from a script.

method.name: clear_context
method.description: Frees all buffers related to this context.

method.name: create_texture
method.description: Create a new texture with the given definition and cache this under the given name. Will return the existing texture if it already exists.

method.name: create_texture_from_format
method.description: Create a new texture using the given format and view and cache this under the given name. Will return the existing texture if it already exists.

method.name: create_texture_view
method.description: Create a new texture view for an existing texture and cache this under the given [param view_name]. Will return the existing texture view if it already exists. Will error if the source texture doesn't exist.

method.name: get_color_layer
method.description: Returns the specified layer from the color texture we are rendering 3D content to. If [param msaa] is [code]true[/code] and MSAA is enabled, this returns the MSAA variant of the buffer.

method.name: get_color_texture
method.description: Returns the color texture we are rendering 3D content to. If multiview is used this will be a texture array with all views. If [param msaa] is [code]true[/code] and MSAA is enabled, this returns the MSAA variant of the buffer.

method.name: get_depth_layer
method.description: Returns the specified layer from the depth texture we are rendering 3D content to. If [param msaa] is [code]true[/code] and MSAA is enabled, this returns the MSAA variant of the buffer.

method.name: get_depth_texture
method.description: Returns the depth texture we are rendering 3D content to. If multiview is used this will be a texture array with all views. If [param msaa] is [code]true[/code] and MSAA is enabled, this returns the MSAA variant of the buffer.

method.name: get_fsr_sharpness
method.description: Returns the FSR sharpness value used while rendering the 3D content (if [method get_scaling_3d_mode] is an FSR mode).

method.name: get_internal_size
method.description: Returns the internal size of the render buffer (size before upscaling) with which textures are created by default.

method.name: get_msaa_3d
method.description: Returns the applied 3D MSAA mode for this viewport.

method.name: get_opaque_late_color
method.experimental: Part of the late opaque pass of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the slice [param layer] of the copy of the scene color made right before the late opaque pass: the opaque and motion passes without surfaces whose shader uses [code]render_mode opaque_late[/code], before the sky is drawn (internal resolution, HDR, one mipmap level, separate specular not merged yet). Late opaque materials read the same texture through [code]hint_screen_texture[/code]. Returns an invalid RID when no late opaque surface was drawn this frame (see [method has_opaque_late_textures]).

method.name: get_opaque_late_depth
method.experimental: Part of the late opaque pass of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the slice [param layer] of the copy of the depth buffer made right before the late opaque pass ([code]R32_SFLOAT[/code], same values as [method get_depth_layer]), i.e. the depth of the scene without late opaque surfaces. Late opaque materials read the same texture through [code]hint_depth_texture[/code]. Compared with [method get_depth_layer] (which includes them), it gives the thickness of a late surface such as water over what lies behind it. Returns an invalid RID when no late opaque surface was drawn this frame (see [method has_opaque_late_textures]).

method.name: get_raytracing_instance_buffer
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the storage buffer with one 128-byte record per instance of the raytracing scene TLAS ([method get_raytracing_tlas]), indexed by the instance custom index ([code]rayQueryGetIntersectionInstanceCustomIndexEXT[/code]). Layout (std430): [code]uvec2 vertex_address, attribute_address, index_address, multimesh_address; uint vertex_count, position_stride, normal_byte_offset, normal_stride, tangent_byte_offset, tangent_stride, attribute_stride, uv_byte_offset, uv_scale_packed, index_format, primitive_count, flags; float aabb_size_x, aabb_size_y, aabb_size_z; uint color_byte_offset; float aabb_pos_x, aabb_pos_y, aabb_pos_z; uint layer_mask, mm_vertices_per_instance, mm_stride, mm_color_offset, mm_custom_offset;[/code]. Addresses are buffer device addresses of the mesh vertex, attribute and index buffers (read with [code]GL_EXT_buffer_reference[/code]); [code]0xFFFFFFFF[/code] offsets mean the attribute is missing. [code]index_format[/code]: 0 = uint16, 1 = uint32, 2 = not indexed. [code]flags[/code]: 1 = compressed positions (unorm16, the TLAS transform includes the AABB), 4 = skinned / blend shapes, 8 = merged MultiMesh (instance = vertex index / [code]mm_vertices_per_instance[/code]), 16 = one MultiMesh instance. [code]multimesh_address[/code] points at the MultiMesh instance data (12 transform floats, then color and custom data at [code]mm_color_offset[/code] / [code]mm_custom_offset[/code] floats). Returns an invalid RID when there is no raytracing scene this frame.

method.name: get_raytracing_instance_count
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the number of instances in the raytracing scene TLAS of this frame (one per mesh surface, merged MultiMesh surface or large-MultiMesh instance).

method.name: get_raytracing_material_buffer
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the storage buffer with one 96-byte material record per TLAS instance (same indexing as [method get_raytracing_instance_buffer]). Layout (std430): [code]uint albedo_texture_idx, normal_texture_idx, orm_texture_idx, emission_texture_idx; vec4 albedo_color; vec3 emission_color; float emission_strength; float metallic, roughness, ao_strength; uint flags; vec2 uv1_scale, uv1_offset; float normal_map_depth, specular, alpha_scissor; uint cull_mode;[/code]. Colors are linear. Texture indices refer to [method get_raytracing_textures] (0 = white). [code]flags[/code]: 1 = normal map, 2 = emission texture, 4 = nearest filter, 8 = albedo uses vertex color, 16 = [ShaderMaterial] (parameters such as [code]albedo[/code], [code]roughness[/code], [code]metallic[/code], [code]emission[/code] are taken by name, custom shader code is not evaluated), 32 = unshaded. Transparent surfaces are not part of the scene.

method.name: get_raytracing_texture_uniform_set
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns a uniform set for [param shader] at index [param set] containing all material textures of the raytracing scene. The set must have a single binding: [code]layout(set = N, binding = 0) uniform texture2D textures[];[/code] (runtime-sized, index with [code]nonuniformEXT[/code]). The set is cached and recreated when textures change.

method.name: get_raytracing_textures
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the material textures of the raytracing scene, indexed by the texture indices of [method get_raytracing_material_buffer]. Index 0 is a white texture.

method.name: get_raytracing_tlas
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns the top-level acceleration structure of the visible scene of this viewport, built at the start of the frame when [member Viewport.raytracing_scene_enabled] is [code]true[/code]. Bind it as [constant RenderingDevice.UNIFORM_TYPE_ACCELERATION_STRUCTURE] and trace it with [code]GL_EXT_ray_query[/code] in compute shaders of [CompositorEffect]s. The instance mask has bits 0-6 for render layers 1-7 and bit 7 for any of layers 8-20. Returns an invalid RID when there is no raytracing scene this frame (see [method has_raytracing_scene]).

method.name: get_render_target
method.description: Returns the render target associated with this buffers object.

method.name: get_scaling_3d_mode
method.description: Returns the scaling mode used for upscaling.

method.name: get_screen_space_aa
method.description: Returns the screen-space antialiasing method applied.

method.name: get_target_size
method.description: Returns the target size of the render buffer (size after upscaling).

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns a cached texture with this name.

method.name: get_texture_format
method.description: Returns the texture format information with which a cached texture was created.

method.name: get_texture_samples
method.description: Returns the number of MSAA samples used.

method.name: get_texture_slice
method.description: Returns a specific slice (layer or mipmap) for a cached texture.

method.name: get_texture_slice_size
method.description: Returns the texture size of a given slice of a cached texture.

method.name: get_texture_slice_view
method.description: Returns a specific view of a slice (layer or mipmap) for a cached texture.

method.name: get_use_debanding
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if debanding is enabled.

method.name: get_use_taa
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if TAA is enabled.

method.name: get_velocity_layer
method.description: Returns the specified layer from the velocity texture we are rendering 3D content to.

method.name: get_velocity_texture
method.description: Returns the velocity texture we are rendering 3D content to. If multiview is used this will be a texture array with all views. If [param msaa] is [b]true[/b] and MSAA is enabled, this returns the MSAA variant of the buffer.

method.name: get_view_count
method.description: Returns the view count for the associated viewport.

method.name: has_opaque_late_textures
method.experimental: Part of the late opaque pass of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the Forward+ renderer drew a late opaque pass for this viewport in the current frame, so [method get_opaque_late_color] and [method get_opaque_late_depth] are valid. Surfaces whose shader uses [code]render_mode opaque_late[/code] are drawn after all other opaque geometry (with a depth and normal-roughness pre-pass and motion vectors), and their [code]hint_screen_texture[/code] / [code]hint_depth_texture[/code] uniforms read the scene drawn before them; such materials stay opaque. Screen-space effects computed before the opaque pass (SSAO, SSIL, SSR) neither include nor shade late surfaces. With MSAA, in reflection probes and on the Mobile and Compatibility renderers there is no late pass: late surfaces are drawn with the other opaque geometry (Forward+) or, on Mobile and Compatibility, as transparent when they read the screen.

method.name: has_raytracing_scene
method.experimental: Part of the raytracing scene of a custom engine build.
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the raytracing scene (TLAS and instance data) was built for this frame. Requires [member Viewport.raytracing_scene_enabled], [member ProjectSettings.rendering/raytracing/scene_acceleration_structures], the Forward+ renderer and a Vulkan device with ray query support ([constant RenderingDevice.SUPPORTS_RAY_QUERY]).

method.name: has_texture
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a cached texture exists for this name.
